verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in debugging agent. Users can hand it several kinds of work: Autofix triages incoming issues, finds root causes, generates code fixes and opens PRs; it reviews code changes; and the Seer Agent answers questions about application telemetry. Sentry Agent can also be assigned Linear issues. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, and deeper documentation of how delegation is scoped and controlled (approval steps, limits).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage. PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Code Review: Have Seer review your code changes in GitHub or GitLab, catching bugs before merging.
Catch critical issues before you merge and fix them when they hit prod with Seer, our debugging agent and code reviewer.
Assign Sentry Agent to Linear issues, debug with Seer.
